chunks: A shaykh from the people of Qaṭīʿat al-Rabīʿ, from the general populace in Baghdad, from those from whom reports were transmitted, narrated to me, saying:

He said: He said to me, “I have indeed seen one of those from the people of this Household whose excellence they speak of, and I have never seen anyone like him at all in his excellence and his devotion.” So I said to him, “Who was he, and how did you see him?”

He said: “During the days of al-Sindī ibn Shāhak, eighty men of standing, ascribed to goodness, were gathered, and we were admitted to Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام). Al-Sindī said to us, ‘O people, look at this man. Has any harm happened to him? The people claim that something has been done to him, and they speak much about that. Here is his lodging and his bedding, made spacious for him and not restricted. The Commander of the Faithful intended no evil for him; rather, he is only keeping him until he comes to debate with the Commander of the Faithful. Here he is, sound, and ease has been granted to him in all his affairs. So ask him.’”

He said: “We had no concern except to look at the man, and at his excellence and his bearing. Then Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) said, ‘As for what he mentioned of spaciousness and the like of it, it is as he said; except that I inform you, O group, that I have been given poison in seven dates. Tomorrow I shall turn green, and the day after tomorrow I shall die.’”
He said: “Then I looked at al-Sindī ibn Shāhak, and he was shaking and trembling like a palm frond.”

key_terms.سَبْعِ تَمَرَاتٍ: seven dates through which the poison was administered
key_terms.سَمْتِهِ: his bearing, manner, and dignified appearance
key_terms.مُوَسَّعٌ عَلَيْهِ: that ease and spaciousness had been outwardly provided for him
key_terms.نُسُكِهِ: his devotion and acts of worship

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim’s knowledge of his martyrdom and the circumstances of his imprisonment?
ai.summary: This narration recounts a witness describing the excellence, devotion, and dignified bearing of Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) while he was imprisoned. It also reports the Imam’s foreknowledge of his poisoning and imminent death, which reflects the chapter’s theme that the Imams know the time of their passing. The report further preserves a historical scene exposing official attempts to conceal wrongdoing against the Imam.
